_comment: Lowest Booking.com rates per room category, SGD inclusive of all taxes & fees (base + quoted taxes line; 'Includes taxes' used as-is; x1.19 estimate only when no tax info shown). Scraped from each competitor's Booking.com property page (not search cards), 2 adults / 1 room / 1 night. by_category maps competitor room names to Heritage Collection categories (Single/Studio/Loft/Suite): explicit keyword match first, then remaining standard rooms ranked by price with cheapest = Studio and higher tiers = Loft. units_left_total sums the maximum bookable units across all room types (drives competitor occupancy). Kinn Habitat: rates use PRIVATE rooms only (dorm capsule beds excluded); units_left_total includes dorm capsules. Dates not re-scraped this run are carried forward from earlier runs.
